W003_I.factor_value_logic: For each source factor, compute full-sample z-score using (x - mean(skipna=True)) / std(skipna=True, ddof=1). W003_I.signal_ls_logic: signal_ls = factor_value / 3, clipped to [-1, 1]; NaN remains NaN.
